recommendations: Halley D. “Amy is an alumna of my university and I reached out to her for career advice. She is very friendly and provides great insights about the tech industry. I learned a lot from her and highly recommend her as a mentor.”

LinkedIn User “I reached out to Amy after she gave a presentation to a club I am in. She has accomplished so much and I wanted to get general career advice from her. I am so glad that I reached out and grateful for all of the amazing information she provided me with! She was incredibly genuine, transparent, and all of her answers were thoughtful -- I ended up taking two pages of notes down while talking with her! It is clear she really cares about mentoring others and sharing her advice and experiences, and for that I am so thankful! If you are looking for someone to share their professional and academic experience with you, definitely chat with Amy!”
